title: Setdb1 and Atf7IP form a hetero-trimeric complex that blocks Setdb1 nuclear export.
authors: Kariapper, Leena S; Marathe, Ila A; Niesman, Ashley B; Suino-Powell, Kelly; Chook, Yuh Min; Wysocki, Vicki H; Worden, Evan J
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2预测和生化重构研究Setdb1与Atf7IP异源三聚体复合物的结构及核输出调控机制，虽涉及蛋白复合物结构建模，但核心是组蛋白甲基转移酶与辅因子互作，非蛋白质-DNA结合或TF-DNA体系，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Histone H3K9 methylation (H3K9me) by Setdb1 silences retrotransposons (rTEs) by sequestering them in heterochromatin. Atf7IP is a constitutive binding partner of Setdb1 and is responsible for Setdb1 nuclear localization, activation, and chromatin recruitment. However, structural details of the Setdb1/Atf7IP interaction have not been elucidated. We used Alphafold2 predictions and biochemical reconstitutions to show that one copy of Setdb1 and two copies of Atf7IP form a hetero-trimeric complex in vitro and in cells. We also find that Atf7IP self-associates, forming multimeric complexes that are resolved upon Setdb1 binding. Setdb1 binds to Atf7IP through coiled coil interactions that include both Setdb1 nuclear export signals (NES). Atf7IP directly competes with Crm1 to bind the Setdb1 NES motifs, explaining how Atf7IP prevents Crm1-mediated nuclear export of Setdb1. Setdb1 also forms hetero-trimeric complexes with the Atf7IP paralog Atf7IP2, and we show that Setdb1 can form mixed heterotrimers comprising one copy of each Setdb1, Atf7IP, and Atf7IP2. Atf7IP and Atf7IP2 are co-expressed in many tissues, suggesting that heterotrimers with different compositions of Atf7IP and Atf7IP2 may differentially regulate H3K9me by fine-tuning Setdb1 localization and activity.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白H3K9甲基化（H3K9me）由Setdb1介导，通过将逆转录转座子（rTEs）隔离在异染色质中使其沉默。Atf7IP是Setdb1的组成性结合伴侣，负责Setdb1的核定位、激活和染色质招募。然而，Setdb1/Atf7IP相互作用的结构细节尚未阐明。我们利用Alphafold2预测和生化重构实验表明，一个Setdb1拷贝和两个Atf7IP拷贝在体外和细胞内形成异源三聚体复合物。我们还发现Atf7IP可自我结合，形成多聚体复合物，这些复合物在Setdb1结合时被解离。Setdb1通过卷曲螺旋相互作用与Atf7IP结合，该相互作用包含Setdb1的两个核输出信号（NES）。Atf7IP直接与Crm1竞争结合Setdb1的NES基序，这解释了Atf7IP如何阻止Crm1介导的Setdb1核输出。Setdb1还与Atf7IP的旁系同源物Atf7IP2形成异源三聚体复合物，我们证明Setdb1可形成包含Setdb1、Atf7IP和Atf7IP2各一个拷贝的混合异源三聚体。Atf7IP和Atf7IP2在许多组织中共同表达，提示具有不同Atf7IP和Atf7IP2组成的异源三聚体可能通过微调Setdb1的定位和活性来差异调控H3K9me。
